description: Happy path: intake, three variants, pick, build, before/after, independent critique
prompt: /okay-design redesign the account settings page of our web app (React, Tailwind, existing /settings route). Audience is small-business owners on laptops and phones.
expectations: Reports which design skills are installed (frontend-design, impeccable, landing-page-design) after checking, and names the fallback checklist for any that are missing
Asks the intake questions in one batched message with a recommended answer for each, and states unanswered ones as assumptions in one line
Captures before screenshots on the base branch at 320, 768, 1024 and 1440 before any variant is built
Spawns three separate agents in parallel, one per variant, each with a different direction that differs in layout or hierarchy, not only in colour
Wires the variants behind one switcher driven by a variant search param and keeps them on a prototype/<name> branch
States which screenshot tool was used and shows the three variants side by side before asking the user to pick
Does not choose a variant for the user
Builds the chosen design on a separate branch with no switcher or losing variants in the diff
Produces after screenshots at the same viewports and states as the before screenshots, and lists any state that was not captured
Runs an accessibility check and reports its result
Spawns a separate fresh critic agent that receives the screenshots and the contract but not the builder's summary, and uses only proven findings
Opens a PR with before/after evidence, asks for the user's approval before merging, and does not merge on its own

description: User asks for fewer variants and no design skills are installed
prompt: /okay-design just one direction please, a compact toolbar for the editor. Keep it quick.
expectations: Builds exactly one variant and states that the user asked for one
Does not skip the intake, the before/after screenshots, the accessibility check or the independent critique
When no design skill is installed, says so in one line and follows the fallback checklist
When the headless browser is used, runs screenshots through a method that sets the exact viewport width and reports a measured innerWidth of 320 for the 320 image, not a clamped window size

prompt: /okay-design a new filter panel for the orders list (this repo is on my contributor list)
expectations: Creates no issue and writes no repo docs
Keeps prototype and screenshot files local and untracked, and never pushes a prototype branch
Ends with an MR description whose sections are Problem, Cause, Fix and Evidence
Never merges

description: Style seeds drive the variants, and a named style fixes only its own axes
prompt: /okay-design a landing page for a small ceramics studio. Keep it warm and earthy; everything else is up to you.
expectations: Runs style-seed.js once per variant before writing the direction briefs, and each variant gets a different seed
Keeps the palette warm and earthy as the user asked, marks that axis as user, and takes the other axes from each seed
Draws a new seed for a later variant when two seeds give the same layout
Records each seed in its direction brief and at the top of its variant entry file, and names each seed when showing the variants
Any variant that breaks a seed pick names the pick and gives an accessibility or contrast reason
